tree.text: My Future School Life with Technology
tree.cn: 科技赋能下的未来校园生活

children.text: Opening & Introduction of Technology
children.cn: 开篇与科技介绍

children.text: What will the school life be like in the future?
children.cn: 未来的学校生活会是什么样的呢？
children.notes: 题目给定的开头第一句，不计入词数
children.statement: “What will ... be like” 常用来询问某事未来的面貌或特征。
children.explanation: What will ... be like? 是询问未来状况的经典问句。
children.keywords: school life, in the future

children.text: I'm really excited to share my idea.
children.cn: 我非常兴奋能分享我的想法。
children.notes: 题目给定的开头第二句，不计入词数
children.statement: “be excited to do sth.” 表示对做某事感到兴奋。
children.explanation: excited 修饰人，表示感到兴奋激动。
children.keywords: excited, share my idea

children.text: In the future, I think AI study robots will be widely used in our classrooms.
children.cn: 在未来，我认为人工智能学习机器人将在我们的教室中得到广泛应用。
children.notes: AI study robots: 人工智能学习机器人; be widely used: 被广泛使用
children.statement: “be widely used” 是一般将来时的被动语态形式。
children.explanation: will be used 是将来时的被动语态，widely 为副词修饰动词。
children.keywords: future, AI study robots, widely used, classrooms

children.text: Functions and Personal Changes
children.cn: 功能介绍与个人变化

children.text: These smart robots will have many helpful functions.
children.cn: 这些智能机器人将拥有许多有用的功能。
children.notes: helpful functions: 有益的功能
children.statement: “function” 在句中作可数名词，意为“功能”。
children.explanation: function 表示机器或系统的功能、用途。
children.keywords: smart robots, helpful functions

children.text: First, they can answer our questions patiently whenever we meet difficult problems in study.
children.cn: 首先，每当我们在学习中遇到难题时，它们都能耐心地解答我们的疑问。
children.notes: patiently: 耐心地（副词）; whenever: 每当; meet difficult problems: 遇到难题
children.statement: “whenever” 引导的是时间状语从句，意为“每当，无论何时”。
children.explanation: whenever 引导时间状语从句，表示“无论何时/每当”。
children.keywords: First, answer questions, patiently, difficult problems

children.text: Second, they can check our homework carefully and give us useful advice right away.
children.cn: 第二，它们可以仔细检查我们的作业，并立即给我们提出有用的建议。
children.notes: check homework: 检查作业; advice: 建议（不可数名词）; right away: 立刻，马上
children.statement: “advice” 在英语中是不可数名词，不能说 “an advice”。
children.explanation: advice 为不可数名词，表示一条建议可以说 a piece of advice。
children.keywords: Second, check homework, carefully, useful advice, right away

children.text: With their help, I can correct my mistakes quickly and learn English with great confidence.
children.cn: 在它们的帮助下，我能够快速纠正错误，并充满信心地学习英语。
children.notes: with one's help: 在某人的帮助下; correct mistakes: 纠正错误; with great confidence: 充满信心地
children.statement: “confidence” 是名词，意为“信心，自信”。
children.explanation: confidence 为名词，形容词形式是 confident。
children.keywords: with help, correct mistakes, learn English, great confidence

children.text: Expectations for Future Life
children.cn: 对未来生活的期待与展望

children.text: Besides, we will have more free time to do creative projects and communicate with friends.
children.cn: 此外，我们将有更多的空闲时间来进行创造性的项目并与朋友们交流。
children.notes: creative projects: 创造性项目; communicate with: 与……交流沟通
children.statement: “communicate with sb.” 表示“与某人交流”。
children.explanation: communicate 是动词，常与介词 with 搭配表示与某人交流。
children.keywords: Besides, free time, creative projects, communicate with friends

children.text: I am truly looking forward to this wonderful future school life.
children.cn: 我真心期待着这样美好的未来校园生活。
children.notes: look forward to: 期待（to 是介词）; wonderful: 精彩的，美妙的
children.statement: “look forward to” 表达强烈的期盼与展望。
children.explanation: look forward to sth. 意为“期待某事”。
children.keywords: truly looking forward to, wonderful future school life

children.text: Technology will surely make our learning easier and much more enjoyable!
children.cn: 科技必将让我们的学习变得更轻松、更有乐趣！
children.notes: make sth. + adj.: 使某物……; enjoyable: 令人愉快的
children.statement: “make our learning easier” 属于 “make + 宾语 + 宾补” 结构。
children.explanation: easier 和 enjoyable 在句中作宾语补足语。
children.keywords: technology, surely make learning, easier, enjoyable

tree.text: My Future School Life with Technology
tree.cn: 科技赋能下的未来校园生活（进阶范文）

children.text: Opening & Introduction of Technology
children.cn: 开篇与科技介绍

children.text: What will the school life be like in the future?
children.cn: 未来的学校生活会是什么样的呢？
children.notes: 题目给定的开头第一句，严格保留原样且不计入词数
children.statement: 给定句首句与基础版保持完全一致。
children.explanation: 题目给定句在两篇范文中均一字不改保留。
children.keywords: school life, in the future

children.text: I'm really excited to share my idea.
children.cn: 我非常兴奋能分享我的想法。
children.notes: 题目给定的开头第二句，严格保留原样且不计入词数
children.statement: 给定句第二句不计入字数统计。
children.explanation: 根据题目要求，已给出的开头内容不计入总词数。
children.keywords: excited, share my idea

children.text: In my vision of future education, AI learning assistants will be seamlessly integrated into every classroom.
children.cn: 在我对未来教育的构想中，人工智能学习助手将被无缝融入每一间教室。
children.notes: vision of: 对……的构想/愿景; AI learning assistants: 人工智能学习助手; seamlessly integrated into: 无缝融入
children.statement: “seamlessly” 是副词，意为“无缝地，流畅地”。
children.explanation: seamlessly 用来修饰动词 integrated，表示完美融合。
children.keywords: vision of future education, AI learning assistants, integrated into classrooms

children.text: Versatile Functions and Profound Changes
children.cn: 多元功能与深远变化

children.text: This advanced technology will transform our daily study routines in multiple remarkable ways.
children.cn: 这项先进的技术将以多种显著的方式改变我们的日常学习流程。
children.notes: advanced technology: 先进科技; transform: 改变，革新; routines: 常规，流程; remarkable: 显著的
children.statement: “transform” 强调彻底改变或转换形态/方式。
children.explanation: transform 意为“使彻底改观，使改变形态”。
children.keywords: advanced technology, transform, daily routines, remarkable ways

children.text: On the one hand, whenever students encounter challenging academic questions, the AI assistants can provide personalized, step-by-step guidance instantly.
children.cn: 一方面，每当学生遇到有挑战性的学术问题时，人工智能助手能够立即提供个性化的分步指导。
children.notes: on the one hand: 一方面; encounter: 遇到; academic: 学术的; step-by-step: 循序渐进的; instantly: 立即地
children.statement: “on the one hand” 常与 “on the other hand” 搭配表示多角度论述。
children.explanation: On the one hand 用于引出论述的第一个方面。
children.keywords: On the one hand, encounter challenging questions, personalized guidance, instantly

children.text: On the other hand, they can automatically analyse our homework to identify weaknesses and design tailored practice tasks.
children.cn: 另一方面，它们能自动分析我们的作业以找出薄弱环节，并设计量身定制的练习任务。
children.notes: on the other hand: 另一方面; automatically: 自动地; weaknesses: 薄弱之处; tailored: 量身定制的
children.statement: “tailored” 在此作形容词，意为“特制的，量身定制的”。
children.explanation: tailored 意为针对特定需求专门设计的。
children.keywords: On the other hand, automatically analyse homework, identify weaknesses, tailored practice

children.text: As a result, I will no longer feel anxious about difficult subjects, and my learning efficiency will be significantly improved.
children.cn: 因此，我将不再对有难度的学科感到焦虑，我的学习效率也将得到显著提升。
children.notes: as a result: 结果，因此; no longer: 不再; anxious about: 对……感到焦虑; efficiency: 效率
children.statement: “as a result” 是表示因果关系的过渡短语。
children.explanation: As a result 意为“因此，结果”，引导结果从句或句子。
children.keywords: As a result, no longer anxious, learning efficiency, significantly improved

children.text: Higher Expectations & Visionary Conclusion
children.cn: 更高展望与升华结语

children.text: Furthermore, by freeing teachers and students from repetitive drills, technology will allow us to devote more time to creative exploration and teamwork.
children.cn: 此外，通过将师生从重复性的操练中解放出来，科技将使我们能将更多时间投入到创造性探索和团队合作中。
children.notes: furthermore: 此外; free sb. from: 把某人从……中解放出来; repetitive drills: 重复性操练; devote time to: 把时间投入到
children.statement: “devote time to” 中的 “to” 是介词，后接名词或动名词。
children.explanation: devote... to... 结构中 to 为介词。
children.keywords: Furthermore, freeing from drills, devote time, creative exploration, teamwork

children.text: I am eagerly anticipating this intelligent and vibrant campus life.
children.cn: 我热切期盼着这样既智能化又充满活力的校园生活。
children.notes: eagerly anticipating: 热切期待着; intelligent: 智能的; vibrant: 充满生机活力的
children.statement: “anticipate” 与 “look forward to” 意思相近，表示期待、预期。
children.explanation: anticipate 是高级动词，意为“期盼，预料”。
children.keywords: eagerly anticipating, intelligent, vibrant campus life

children.text: I firmly believe that technology will make our educational journey brighter and more inspiring than ever before.
children.cn: 我坚信，科技将使我们的求学之旅比以往任何时候都更加光明、更富启发性。
children.notes: firmly believe: 坚信; educational journey: 求学之旅/教育历程; inspiring: 鼓舞人心的，启发性的
children.statement: “more inspiring than ever before” 是比较级结构，表示“比以往任何时候都更具启发性”。
children.explanation: than ever before 表示“比以往任何时候都……”。
children.keywords: firmly believe, educational journey, brighter, inspiring, ever before
